how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, one jest suite run, then `git checkout -- <file>` before the next row. Driver: a per-task script (not committed) that reads the table below. `redTests` are the names that went red. Run on maintainer-mac-2, 2026-10-31.
note: Three rows were re-issued by the second driver after their text turned out not to match the source (a NO-MATCH is not a proof); this file holds only the corrected rows that actually went red.

redTests: leaves every other cell byte-for-byte identical; appends new cell keys instead of re-sorting the table; reports the cells it changed

redTests: leaves every other cell byte-for-byte identical; appends new cell keys instead of re-sorting the table; replaces a component of the same name rather than duplicating it

redTests: keeps the components block the file already had; merges one component and leaves the rest of the file alone
